verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
May this lowly bread and wine
Be the sacrifice divine

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Of our Saviour Jesus Christ
Of our Saviour Jesus Christ

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
All man's labour can produce
You have given for our use

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Take O Lord our offering
Take O Lord our offering

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
On this gift of bread and wine
Of our sacrifice a sign

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Father look with favour now
Father look with favour now

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
May this food which strength imparts
Bring refreshment to our hearts

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
And a taste of joy to come
And a taste of joy to come
